newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bre-X Jakarta partner says deal likely on Busang.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X Jakarta partner says deal likely on Busang.

text.p: The Indonesian partner of Canadian mining firm Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Monday he was optimistic a solution would emerge in November in their ownership dispute over the Busang gold find in Kalimantan.
"My lawyer met their (Bre-X) lawyer and there have been some good signs. I think a solution will be found in November," Jusuf Merukh told Reuters.
Merukh said his lawyer was scheduled to hold a second round of talks with his Bre-X counterpart later this year.
He also said he would meet the Indonesian director-general of mines, Kuntoro Mangkusubroto, next week for talks.
Merukh is seeking a 40-percent stake in the spectacular find, estimated to hold gold reserves of up to 47 million ounces, and has been locked in an ownership dispute with Bre-X over the property.
Meanwhile, Kuntoro told Reuters on Monday that Bre-X had reported to him a week ago "giving some good signs" that its ownership dispute would be resolved. He did not elaborate.
He, however, reiterated, that the government could not sign the contract of work with Bre-x until the dispute was resolved.
Kuntoro has previously said the government had delayed signing the contract of work until the problem was sorted out.
